description: Utility object UdfUtils providing conversion functions for user-defined functions (UDFs) and other functional adapters in Spark SQL, shared between client and server for UDF execution compatibility.

classes.name: UdfUtils
classes.description: Object containing static utility methods for converting and wrapping user-defined functions (UDFs) and other functional interfaces for Spark SQL.

methods.name: mapFuncToMapPartitionsAdaptor
methods.description: Converts a function T => U into an iterator-based mapPartitions adaptor.

methods.name: foreachFuncToForeachPartitionsAdaptor
methods.description: Converts a function T => Unit into an iterator-based foreachPartitions adaptor.

methods.name: foreachPartitionFuncToMapPartitionsAdaptor
methods.description: Wraps a iterator-based function into a mapPartitions adaptor returning an empty iterator.

methods.name: flatMapFuncToMapPartitionsAdaptor
methods.description: Converts a function T => IterableOnce[U] into an iterator-based mapPartitions adaptor.

methods.name: filterFuncToScalaFunc
methods.description: Converts a Java FilterFunction to a Scala function.

methods.name: mapFunctionToScalaFunc
methods.description: Converts a Java MapFunction to a Scala function.

methods.name: mapPartitionsFuncToScalaFunc
methods.description: Converts a Java MapPartitionsFunction to a Scala function.

methods.name: foreachFuncToScalaFunc
methods.description: Converts a Java ForeachFunction to a Scala function.

methods.name: foreachPartitionFuncToScalaFunc
methods.description: Converts a Java ForeachPartitionFunction to a Scala function.

methods.name: foreachBatchFuncToScalaFunc
methods.description: Converts a Java VoidFunction2 to a Scala function for batch processing.

methods.name: flatMapFuncToScalaFunc
methods.description: Converts a Java FlatMapFunction to a Scala function.

methods.name: flatMapGroupsFuncToScalaFunc
methods.description: Converts a Java FlatMapGroupsFunction to a Scala function.

methods.name: mapGroupsFuncToScalaFunc
methods.description: Converts a Java MapGroupsFunction to a Scala function.

methods.name: coGroupFunctionToScalaFunc
methods.description: Converts a Java CoGroupFunction to a Scala function.

methods.name: mapGroupsFuncToFlatMapAdaptor
methods.description: Wraps a function (K, Iterator[V]) => U into a (K, Iterator[V]) => IterableOnce[U] adaptor.

methods.name: mapValuesAdaptor
methods.description: Creates an adaptor for mapping values with a value mapping function.

methods.name: mapValuesAdaptor
methods.description: Creates an adaptor for mapping values with multiple functions and iterators.

methods.name: mapValuesAdaptor
methods.description: Creates an adaptor for mapping values with a function involving GroupState.

methods.name: mapGroupsWithStateFuncToFlatMapAdaptor
methods.description: Wraps a (K, Iterator[V], GroupState[S]) => U function into an iterator adaptor.

methods.name: mapGroupsWithStateFuncToScalaFunc
methods.description: Converts a Java MapGroupsWithStateFunction to a Scala function.

methods.name: flatMapGroupsWithStateFuncToScalaFunc
methods.description: Converts a Java FlatMapGroupsWithStateFunction to a Scala function.

methods.name: mapReduceFuncToScalaFunc
methods.description: Converts a ReduceFunction to a Scala binary function.

methods.name: identical
methods.description: Returns a function that returns its input unchanged.

methods.name: noOp
methods.description: Returns a function that always returns null casted to K.

methods.name: iterableOnceToSeq
methods.description: Converts a function returning IterableOnce[B] to a function returning Seq[B].

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Wraps a Java UDF (from 0 to 22 arguments) into a Scala function or object.
